rationale: DFT scan is per-implementation, not protocol-level

extraction_strategy.ic_class_applicability_gate_v0_1_62: ic_class='serial_peripheral_protocol' declares LL20 not applicable; emitted as N/A stub (l_doc_taxonomy.na_stub)

fields.notes: SAS's protocol-level DFT surface is SMP (REPORT GENERAL / DISCOVER / REPORT PHY ERROR LOG), the OOB/speed-negotiation status, connection outcomes, per-frame CRC/ACK-NAK results, and physical-layer test patterns / loopback. Chip-level JTAG / scan / BIST remain controller-vendor / SoC-integrator concerns; conformance is established by INCITS T10 compliance testing.

exposed_dft_features.name: PCI BIST capability
exposed_dft_features.purpose: PCI cfg offset 0Fh — Stat BIST invokes vendor BIST.

exposed_dft_features.name: SATA BIST FIS (Type 0x58)
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Software-built BIST Activate FIS for device loopback.

exposed_dft_features.name: Activity LED + PxCMD.CCS
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Visual + register-level observability of current slot.

exposed_dft_features.name: Received FIS Structure
exposed_dft_features.purpose: Software can dump DSFIS / PSFIS / RFIS / SDBFIS / UFIS.

fields.no_jtag_on_connector: There is no JTAG / scan port on the SATA connector.
fields.scan_chain_topology: AHCI does not define a scan-chain topology.
bist_engines_in_hba: Vendor PHY BIST: PRBS / clock-pattern / packet-loopback.

in_band_test_facilities.name: SMP REPORT PHY ERROR LOG
in_band_test_facilities.purpose: Per-phy error counters (invalid dword, running-disparity, loss-of-dword-sync, phy reset problem).

internal_diagnostics_observability: Phy state (OOB / speed negotiation / dword sync / ready).
Per-phy error log counters via SMP.
SSP frame CRC / ACK / NAK results.
out_of_band_test_facilities: INCITS T10 SAS interoperability / compliance testing.
Vendor SerDes / controller bring-up and characterization tooling (implementation-defined).
